# fish completion for mgit (generated by `mgit --completions fish`)
complete -c mgit -l mouse -x -d 'mouse reports: on for the wheel and clicks, off to keep the terminal\'s own text selection'
complete -c mgit -l sync -x -d 'synchronized output (DEC 2026): frames drawn whole once the terminal answers that it has it; on, off or auto (default)'
complete -c mgit -l width-probe -x -d 'measure how wide the terminal draws characters at start-up (waits at most 150 ms for a terminal that never answers); on (default) or off (TUI_WIDTH_PROBE=off does the same)'
complete -c mgit -l borders -x -d 'box drawing: auto (ASCII only if the terminal draws box characters wide), unicode or ascii (TUI_BORDERS=ascii|unicode does the same)'
complete -c mgit -l completions -x -d 'print a shell completion script (bash, zsh or fish) and exit'
complete -c mgit -l help -d 'show this help'
complete -c mgit -l version -d 'print the version and exit'
